# JUDO UI TypeScript REST Generator

> A code generator that produces TypeScript REST API client code from JUDO UI metamodels (EMF `.model` files), outputting three composable layers: data interfaces, service abstractions, and Axios HTTP implementations.

Key facts:
- Java 21, Maven 3.9.4 multi-module project (5 modules)
- Handlebars templating with Spring SpEL expressions and Eclipse EMF metamodels
- Part of the BlackBelt JUDO framework ecosystem (`hu.blackbelt.judo.generator` group)
- Integration tested by generating TypeScript from an ActionGroupTest model and running Vitest
- License: Eclipse Public License 2.0 (EPL-2.0)

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview, usage examples, architecture diagrams, and build instructions
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Developer guide with directory structure, build commands, coding conventions, and helper class reference
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup, issue reporting, and PR process
- [.github/CIFLOW.md](.github/CIFLOW.md): CI/CD flow and GitFlow branching strategy with diagrams

## Modules — Shared Utilities

- [judo-ui-typescript-rest-commons/pom.xml](judo-ui-typescript-rest-commons/pom.xml): Shared Java helpers (naming conventions, string utils, EMF XMI ID access) used by all generation modules

## Modules — Code Generation

- [judo-ui-typescript-rest-api/pom.xml](judo-ui-typescript-rest-api/pom.xml): Generates `data-api/` — TypeScript interfaces, enums, serializers, query customizers, mask builders, filter types
- [judo-ui-typescript-rest-service/pom.xml](judo-ui-typescript-rest-service/pom.xml): Generates `data-service/` — service interfaces for CRUD, relations, and access control
- [judo-ui-typescript-rest-axios/pom.xml](judo-ui-typescript-rest-axios/pom.xml): Generates `data-axios/` — Axios HTTP client implementations of all service interfaces

## Modules — Testing

- [judo-ui-typescript-rest-itest/pom.xml](judo-ui-typescript-rest-itest/pom.xml): Integration tests — generates TypeScript from ActionGroupTest model and runs Vitest

## Depends on

- [judo-meta-ui](../../models/judo-meta-ui): UI metamodel — pages, containers, tables, inputs, and data bindings
- [judo-generator-commons](../../runtime/judo-generator-commons): Handlebars template-based code generation framework

## Used by

- [judo-ui-e2e-template](../judo-ui-e2e-template): Generates Playwright E2E test projects from UI models
- [judo-ui-react-template](../judo-ui-react-template): Generates React/TypeScript frontend applications from UI models
